title: nf-SMFONT
description: nf-smfont is a comprehensive Nextflow pipeline for Single Molecule Footprinting (SMF) analysis using Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) data. The pipeline processes raw ONT sequencing data (pod5/fast5 files) or pre-processed BAM/CRAM files to identify transcription factor binding sites, chromatin accessibility, and co-occupancy patterns at single-molecule resolution.
